simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to בְּעָלוֹת (H1175) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-loc.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: בְּעָלוֹת (Bᵉʻâlôwth) means Bealoth , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: 1Kgs 4 16.

definitions.usage: Bealoth, in Aloth (by mistake for a plural from 5927 with prepositional prefix).
definitions.full: H1175. Bealoth בְּעָלוֺת proper name, of a location plural Josh 15:24 ; 1Kin 4:16 , a city in the south of Judah, possibly the same as II. בַּעַל .
